fato_historico: 1967: Guerrilla leader Che Guevara and his men are captured in Bolivia.  Guevara would be executed the next day.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may find that clearing away old clutter brings unexpected peace. Much like the quiet transition of legends in history, remember that endings are often the necessary ground for new growth. It is a good time to reflect on your path, trust your intuition, and consider what truly deserves your energy as you build your future.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the grace of your own transformation.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of your personal truth and inner wisdom.
conselho: Trust your process and let go of what no longer serves your growth.
